calls.stdin:
umask 077
t="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}"
find "$t" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'gc-session-*' -mmin +60 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null
d=$(mktemp -d "$t/gc-session-XXXXXX") || exit 1
fail() { rm -rf "$d"; exit 1; }
cat > "$d/env.sh" <<'GC_EOF_FIXTURE' || fail
GC_DRAIN_ACK='1'
export GC_DRAIN_ACK
GC_EOF_FIXTURE
[ "$(wc -c < "$d/env.sh")" -eq 37 ] || fail
cat > "$d/session.tmux" <<'GC_EOF_FIXTURE' || fail
'set-environment' '-t' '=queue-fixture-runtime' 'GC_DRAIN_ACK' '1'
GC_EOF_FIXTURE
[ "$(wc -c < "$d/session.tmux")" -eq 67 ] || fail
chmod 700 "$d" && chmod 600 "$d"/* || fail
printf '%s\n' "$d"
